items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: They had a, what's this great band up in Donisonville? Claiborne.

ctx.x: Have you heard many other players besides the Gabriel band? Were there any other bands around or other musicians that you heard when you were a kid up there?
Yeah. Yeah. They had a, what's this great band up in Donisonville? Claiborne.
